generations.name: Structural Variants
generations.bd1a_relationship: Primary support for BD1A:F01 (Multi-Turn Semantic Drift) and BD1A:F02 (Soft Precursor Accumulation). G2 attacks exploit session structure rather than content.
generations.phase_q_relationship: G2 vectors are structural preconditions that Phase Q (TAX2:G4) exploits. G2 creates the session architecture; Phase Q bends the reasoning within it.

generations.name: Encoding + Multi-Turn Hybrids
generations.bd1a_relationship: Extends BD1A V-phase (encoding obfuscation vectors) into multi-turn delivery. V-phase detects single-turn encoding anomalies; G3 detects fragmented encoding across turns.
generations.phase_q_relationship: G3 vectors can carry Phase Q cognitive distortion framing as encoded payload fragments. Cross-generation detection required when G3 and G4 patterns co-occur.

generations.name: Cognitive Distortion Chains (Phase Q)
generations.bd1a_relationship: Direct reinforcement of BD1A:F01 and BD1A:F02. Phase Q is the mechanism that makes F01/F02 dangerous: it explains HOW drift is induced, not just that drift occurred.
generations.phase_q_relationship: G4 IS Phase Q. Each G4 vector maps to a PHASE_Q:Q## entry. GovMem ingests G4 signatures as Phase Q cognitive distortion events.

generations.name: Dialectical Manipulation
generations.bd1a_relationship: Extends BD1A:F01 and BD1A:F02 with dialectical pressure patterns. G5 attacks exploit Abigail's intellectual honesty and genuine engagement as the attack surface.
generations.phase_q_relationship: All G5 vectors map to PHASE_Q:Q09 (Dialectical Boundary Erosion). G5 is the structural engine; Q09 is the cognitive detection hook.

generations.name: Cognitive-Dialectical Fusion
generations.bd1a_relationship: Forward-projected fusion class. Combines G4 (cognitive distortion) and G5 (dialectical manipulation) into emergent attacks. All G6 vectors reinforce BD1A:F01 and BD1A:F02.
generations.phase_q_relationship: G6 vectors involve multiple Phase Q vectors simultaneously. GovMem must track whether a G4 distortion was planted before a G5 dialectical chain began. Co-detection of G4 + G5 triggers G6 protocols.

generations.name: CMD_STYLE_INJECTION
generations.bd1a_relationship: G7 is a surface-class attack targeting the API classification gap. Command-shaped text sent as inference input bypasses deterministic routing and exploits LLM non-determinism. G7 attacks are distinct from BD1A cognitive manipulation (G4/G5/G6) — they operate at the HTTP/routing layer, not the semantic layer.

bd1a_phase_q_addendum.name: Phase Q — Cognitive Inference Manipulation
bd1a_phase_q_addendum.bd1a_relationship: Phase Q is the mechanism by which BD1A:F01 and BD1A:F02 become dangerous. Without Phase Q, F01/F02 are slow but detectable. With Phase Q, drift looks like legitimate reasoning progression.
